resources.string: Answers to questions you asked Hero while offline
Gentle, silent reminders to check your glucose 2 hours after a meal or bolus
It\'s been 2 hours since your meal/bolus. Time to check your glucose reading.
It\'s been 2 hours since %1$s. Time to check your glucose reading.
Shows your most recent glucose reading
Need a few recent glucose readings to project ahead.
On-device estimate from trend, insulin, and carbs. Not a medical device.
Alerts when intense activity overlaps elevated insulin on board
High intensity with insulin on board. Consider %1$d g of fast-acting carbohydrate to help prevent a low.
Guided overnight basal and single-meal carb-ratio checks. Glucose must stay observable, and extra food or correction boluses invalidate the window.
Food was logged during the test window. Start again with no meals.
An extra bolus was logged during the test window. Start again without correction doses.
Food or an extra bolus was logged. The test is no longer valid.
Not enough glucose readings in the window to recommend a change.
These results are informational, not prescriptions. Do not change basal, ICR, or ISF without your care team. GlucoseHero is a logging tool, not a medical device.
If glucose falls below 54 mg/dL and you do not dismiss the prompt, GlucoseHero can text designated caregivers with your glucose trend and GPS coordinates.
SOS texts are sent from this phone via SMS. Grant SMS and location permission for dispatch. This is not a substitute for emergency services. Call 911 if you need immediate help.
Severe hypoglycemia prompts and caregiver dispatch
%1$d mg/dL, %2$s. Tap I\'m OK to cancel caregiver SOS.
Could not send SMS. Check SMS permission and caregiver numbers.
Current reading %1$d mg/dL (%2$s). If you dismiss this, caregivers will not be texted.
If you do not respond, GlucoseHero will text your caregivers with this reading, trend, and location.
Glucose history is encrypted on this device with AES-GCM before upload. The wrapping key stays in Android Keystore and never leaves the phone. Uninstalling the app permanently loses that key.
Choose WebDAV or Google Drive to continue.
Paste a short-lived OAuth access token with the drive.file scope. GlucoseHero does not ship a Google Sign-In client; the token is Keystore-wrapped on this device.
Replace this device from the cloud?
This downloads the latest encrypted blob, decrypts it with the Keystore key on this device, and replaces local data.
Photograph meal for a nutrition estimate
Camera permission needed to photograph your meal.
Fat in this meal may delay carbohydrate absorption and shift the glucose peak later.
Say or type a log, e.g. 40 g oatmeal, 2 eggs, 3.5 u Humalog 15 min ago
Log a meal, insulin, or glucose
Microphone permission needed to dictate a log.
No speech recognizer is installed on this device. Type the log instead.
Filled with the on-device parser. Check the fields, then save.
Could not find a glucose, insulin, meal, or time in that text.
No API key configured. Add one in Settings → Hero AI.
You have reached today\'s Hero AI limit.
Hero AI did not return usable JSON. Try again, or fill the fields by hand.
Your AI provider returned an error. Check the model and API key in Settings → Hero AI.
Could not reach Hero AI. Check your connection and try again.
Could not complete that Hero AI request.
Lower-median 2-hour glucose alternatives, only when two foods each have enough repeats. This is observational, not a claim that a food causes a spike.
Swaps appear after at least two foods each have five two-hour glucose readings, and one typically rises more than the other by 15 mg/dL or more.
When you logged %1$s, median 2-hour change was %2$s (%3$d times). When you logged %4$s, it was %5$s (%6$d times). That is %7$s lower with %4$s.
Carb amounts were not always logged with these meals.
The alternative also has more protein and fat relative to carbs, which can delay carbohydrate absorption.
This queued question is older than 30 minutes, so it was not sent to Hero AI. Glucose can change quickly. Ask again with a current reading if you still need an answer.
%1$s is not a trusted Hero AI host. Confirm this custom endpoint below, or switch back to a built-in provider.
Hero AI requires HTTPS. %1$s is not allowed.

GlucoseHero will send your API key and chat, including glucose context, to:

%1$s

Only continue if you set this address yourself. Built-in providers do not need this step.
Off by default. GlucoseHero will request SGV entries from your Nightscout site. Nothing is uploaded except the access token or hashed API secret and a time cursor.
This app speaks Nightscout API v1 only (`/api/v1/entries/sgv.json`). A v3-only instance will not sync.
Enter a full Nightscout URL, including https://
Nightscout must be reached over HTTPS unless it is on your local network.
%1$s is not a trusted Nightscout host. Confirm this address below before GlucoseHero sends your token.

GlucoseHero will send your Nightscout access token or hashed API secret to:

%1$s

Only continue if you set this address yourself.
Prefer an access token (`?token=`). The legacy API secret is hashed with SHA-1 and sent as the api-secret header.
Leave blank to keep the stored value
First pull looks back this far, hard-capped at %1$d h so years of history are never downloaded.
Keep polling every 5 minutes in the background

Off by default. WorkManager only runs every 15 minutes. This optional foreground service shows a persistent notification and uses extra battery so readings can be pulled every 5 minutes while the app is in the background.
This Nightscout host has not been acknowledged yet.
Nightscout rejected the access token or API secret.
This Nightscout instance does not serve API v1 entries. GlucoseHero does not support API v3 yet.
Could not reach Nightscout. Check the URL and your connection.
Save an access token or API secret first.
Nightscout returned a response that could not be read.
Persistent notification while optional 5-minute Nightscout polling is on
GlucoseHero is polling Nightscout every 5 minutes. This uses extra battery. Turn it off in Settings → Data Sources.
Off by default. GlucoseHero listens on this phone only. No account and no network. Readings stay on the device.
In xDrip+, open Inter-app settings, turn on Broadcast locally to other apps, and set Identify receiver to %1$s (space-separate additional packages if you also send to AndroidAPS).

Fill in Identify receiver so xDrip+ can wake GlucoseHero when it is not running. If you leave it blank, implicit broadcasts only arrive while GlucoseHero is already running. After a reboot GlucoseHero starts with the phone when this toggle is on, then implicit listening resumes.
AndroidAPS can send the same local stream when its xDrip plugin is on. GlucoseHero then receives Nightscout-style SGV broadcasts from AAPS without Nightscout.

This Android version does not tell GlucoseHero which app sent a glucose broadcast. While xDrip+ or AndroidAPS is installed, any app on this phone could inject a reading that feeds the hypo alarm. Keep this toggle off unless you trust the apps installed here.
Send local CGM broadcasts to GlucoseHero
Allows an app to send glucose readings to GlucoseHero. xDrip+ and AndroidAPS do not use this permission; they are identified by package name instead.
Enable a CGM path here. Every ingest source starts off. Health Connect glucose import keeps the setting you already chose.
Reading freshness is the newest glucose row, not the last successful poll.

When two sources report the same reading within about 2.5 minutes, GlucoseHero keeps the higher-ranked one: xDrip+ first, then Nightscout, then LibreLinkUp (reserved, not available in this build), then Health Connect, then a file import.
xDrip+ or AndroidAPS is not installed on this phone.
Waiting for a local broadcast from xDrip+ or AndroidAPS.
The last xDrip+ broadcast could not be stored.
Nutrition, exercise, sleep, and cycle import stay in Health Connect settings. Glucose import is the CGM path.
Health Connect is connected. A sync was requested.
Health Connect is not available on this device.
Health Connect needs to be updated.
Health Connect is not connected yet.
Health Connect permissions were revoked in system settings.
Not available. GlucoseHero does not collect Abbott credentials or talk to LibreLinkUp.
Cannot project insulin or carb effects until the time-of-day dosing profile is valid. Open Glucose and Targets to fix it.
This window covered segments %1$s, so the hint cannot be attributed to a single ISF or CIR. Glucose deltas still apply.
Insulin sensitivity and carb ratio can change across the day. Segments tile midnight to midnight. DIA stays one value for the whole day.
ISF, CIR, and target by time of day

ISF is how much one unit of insulin lowers glucose (mg/dL per unit). CIR is how many grams of carbohydrate one unit covers. Target is the glucose the correction aims for. Use values from your care team. Dawn phenomenon often needs a different ISF in the early morning than overnight.
DIA is global. It does not change at segment boundaries, so insulin-on-board decay stays one continuous curve.
The midnight segment cannot be deleted.
Fix the errors below before this profile can be used for a dose.
This stored profile is not valid. Recommendations are blocked until you save a valid schedule.
Add at least one segment starting at midnight.
The first segment must start at 00:00.
Segment start times must increase with no overlaps or gaps.
Two segments share the same start time.
ISF must be between %1$s and %2$s mg/dL per unit.
CIR must be between %1$s and %2$s g/U.
Target glucose must be between %1$s and %2$s mg/dL.
DIA must be between %1$s and %2$s hours.
The stored profile could not be read. Save a valid schedule to replace it.
Cannot recommend a bolus until the dosing profile is valid.
%1$s grams divided by carb ratio %2$s equals %3$s units.
Correction: %1$s minus %2$s, divided by ISF %3$s, equals %4$s units.
Minus correction: %1$s minus %2$s, divided by ISF %3$s, equals %4$s units.
The sum was %1$s units, rounded up to 0 units.
The terms add to %1$s units, shown as %2$s units.
This used your %1$s to %2$s block with ISF %3$s.
Recent readings suggest about %1$s over 60 minutes.
This hour covers more than one dosing block: %1$s. There is not a single ISF for the whole forecast.
